turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and a call at 4:40. The zero went into the gradebook and Owen found out on his phone, in the middle of class. Start there.
Don't thank me yet. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
Go ahead, Hale. I'm writing down what you say, so be specific: which document, what dates, and what exactly it shows about Owen's essay.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You told me you wanted to walk me through what you found in the version history, but you did not say what it showed or give me any dates. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn today, that you put in writing exactly what the version history shows, and that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your written reply by end of day Thursday, November 12.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening, still demanding the zero withdrawn, an apology and the principal, with nothing agreed.
Moved at: none
